## Acceptance criteria
1. From any M2 template, "plan week" produces a macro-fitting plan <30 s; slot edits
   re-deal <100 ms (emulator Macrobenchmark regression-tracked).
2. List generation <1 s, unit-consolidated ("300 g rice + 200 g rice → 500 g");
   servings change reconciles deltas.
3. Pantry deduction + check-off flows work offline; export round-trip
text: **M5 implementation complete — 2026-09-13.** Acceptance criteria: (1) Plan week from M2 targets deals 21 slots in <30 s (test asserts wall-clock; report present with fit badges R-S7 ±5%); slot swap re-deal measured **1.02 ms median on the API 29 emulator** (benchmark module `:benchmarks`, self-instrumenting `am instrument` baseline — ~100× under the 100 ms budget; absolute numbers remain functional-only per WLO-0014). (2) List generation unit-consolidated (tbsp/ml/g merges, 2+3=5 property-pinned) <1 s; servings/qty changes reconcile deltas with checks-safe regeneration banner. (3) Pantry deduction (R-S5 default OFF + one-time prompt) + check-off offline; text/CSV/JSON exports; CSV round-trip incl. corrupt-CSV → honest error. (4) Golden planner scenarios (vegetarian+high-fiber, low-FODMAP, calorie-floor honest miss) + kotest property tests (consolidation order-independence, revert-restores-exactly, aisle totality). (5) R-B1 verified: planned→confirmed/replaced links shift DayView planned scalars (test-pinned; replace links a logged diary entry). Content: 52 CC0 recipes + 144 grocery items with validator suite (Atwater arithmetic within 2%+2 kcal, R-S8 FODMAP vocabulary, aisle coverage). Tests: 267+ JVM, 41 instrumented green; D1–D7+D9 clean; schema v6 (7 planning tables, chained migration test to v6). Flags: slot budget shares 25/35/40/15 + macro ±10% band are published invented defaults; 6th FODMAP tag `unknown` = honest uncategorized; barcode check-in typed-first (camera stays an M4 port-level test); `wlo://list`, `wlo://pantry` registry additions (IA owner). Part B notes: cook-event slot swaps deal plain successors (documented corner).
